Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all molecules in document CHEMBL4017441. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Preserve all rows including duplicates from multiple compound_records. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id.
